source: User answers 2026-10-29 plus conservative defaults where user delegated ('do that for all the other sections')

account.notes: Cash account: T+1 settlement, no margin, good-faith-violation risk if proceeds are reused before settlement. No PDT rule applies but GFV rule does.

approval.rule: Every order is presented to the user and requires an explicit 'okay' before submission. Robinhood-side toggle is not relied upon.

further_reduction_triggers: earnings inside holding window -> step down one tier or reject
correlated open position -> combined exposure counts as one position
position_sizing.status: CONFIRMED BY USER 2026-10-29: expose 10-25% of account buying power per trade depending on market pricing and conditions (regime schedule below). Less than 10% is permitted when the risk budget requires it.

per_trade_loss.user_words: In case of loss risk only 20 to 30% per trade
per_trade_loss.interpretation_adopted_CONSERVATIVE: USER CONFIRMED 2026-10-29 01:25 -05: 20-30% of the POSITION value. Example from user: $2,000 account, $100 trade -> exit at a $30 loss to protect the remaining $70. Max loss per trade in dollars = position_value x stop_pct. Worst case 25% x 30% = 7.5% of buying power.
per_trade_loss.stop_placement_rule: Stop must sit at technical invalidation. If invalidation requires more than 30% of position value, reduce size or reject. If invalidation is tighter than 20%, use the tighter stop (less risk is always allowed).
per_trade_loss.options_rule: For long options max loss = full premium. Premium paid must be <= the dollar loss budget (position_value x stop_pct), NOT the full position allowance. Example: $1,000 account, growth regime -> $200 allowance -> $60 max premium at 30% stop.
per_trade_loss.gap_risk_note: A stop is a close rule, not a guarantee; gap-through fills can exceed the 30% budget. Position size, not only the stop, bounds real loss.
per_trade_loss.stop_execution_rule: Hard exit when the position's unrealized loss reaches the approved stop (20-30% of position value, placed at technical invalidation within that band). No widening, no averaging down. Stop order placed as a limit-protected stop where supported; gap-through risk is accepted and disclosed per trade.

circuit_breakers_DEFAULTS.action_on_trigger: No new positions until next day/week respectively; existing positions managed per exit rules only; user notified.

triggers: unexplained position or order appears in account

execution_DEFAULTS.equity_limit_rule: limit <= verified ask x 1.005 (0.5% band); reject if ask moved > 1% from analysis quote
execution_DEFAULTS.option_limit_rule: limit between mid and ask, never above verified ask; reject if ask moved > 5% from analysis quote
execution_DEFAULTS.duplicate_check: fingerprint = account|ticker|instrument_id|side|qty|limit|strategy|expiry|strike|right; block if match in open orders or last 24h fills

options_DEFAULTS.earnings_inside_dte: reject unless the thesis is explicitly an earnings trade and user approves
options_DEFAULTS.status: ALL OPTIONS REJECTED until account options level is verified >= Level 2 (Level 3 for spreads)

screening_DEFAULTS.list_b_affordability: share price <= 25% of buying power, or fractional available; min market cap $2B; min avg dollar volume $20M; price >= $5

holding_period.time_stop: If no progress toward target_1 within 15 trading days and thesis not advanced, exit or reduce.
